# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands

The `surreal` executable exposes a single entry point with **subcommands** for running the server, executing SurrealQL, importing and exporting data, and maintenance tasks. Each page documents that subcommand’s arguments, related environment variables, and typical usage.
**Sidebar order:** [`start`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/start) and [`sql`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/sql) first, then remaining subcommands alphabetically.  
| Subcommand  | Purpose  |  
| --- | --- |  
| [`start`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/start)  | Run a SurrealDB server (in memory, on disk, or clustered).  |  
| [`sql`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/sql)  | Open an interactive SurrealQL shell or run queries from scripts.  |  
| [`export`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/export)  | Dump a database to SurrealQL.  |  
| [`fix`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/fix)  | Apply data or schema fixes offline.  |  
| [`help`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/help)  | Show help for the CLI or a subcommand.  |  
| [`import`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/import)  | Load SurrealQL from a file into a database.  |  
| [`isready`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/isready)  | Health check for readiness probes.  |  
|  [`mcp`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/mcp) Available since: v3.1.0  | Start the Model Context Protocol server on stdio for IDE integrations.  |  
| [`ml`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/ml)  | Work with machine-learning features from the CLI.  |  
| [`module`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/module)  | Build and manage WASM modules (including Surrealism).  |  
| [`upgrade`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/upgrade)  | Upgrade between SurrealDB versions.  |  
| [`validate`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/validate)  | Validate SurrealQL or configuration.  |  
| [`version`](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/commands/version)  | Print CLI and server version information.  |  
For installation and a minimal end-to-end example, see the [SurrealDB CLI overview](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/overview). For environment variables that mirror CLI flags, see [Environment variables](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli/surrealdb-cli/environment-variables).
